items.title: Chico Hamilton interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 30, 2000
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Buddy Tate. [INTERVIEWEE] Buddy — well even Buddy.

ctx.x: Exactly. It’s not putting Fred or Buddy down or putting anybody down, it’s just that I’m a different person. And my newest, the “Timely” album, is living proof of hey, you might not like it as well but hey what the hell, it’s what I’m doing now. Somebody likes it because it’s been moving. And I’m still doing it and I’m still playing all over the world, which is cool. But it’s like how many Benny Goodman bands really did it? How many Count Basie bands did it?
